mode: offline semantic examples; no paid model execution or runtime phrase filter
rubric: Introduce Blueprint honestly and explain why this workflow is relevant to the purpose.
Use the recorded public detail; keep facts and inference distinct without internal-disclaimer paragraphs.
Use a concrete useful observation when supported, rather than a generic research-brief pitch.
Ask one easy non-confidential task/workflow question suited to known site state.
Preserve recipient choice; do not invent a relationship, manual process, robotics interest, fit, promise or follow-up.
Review factual claims and contract anchors against the real brief separately; these examples grant no approval.

facts: P4Swiss/Lindel does CNC milling in Tucson

cases.body: I'm building Blueprint to help businesses explore where robots could fit into their operations. I saw P4Swiss/Lindel does CNC milling in Tucson, and I'm learning how shops handle the work around the machines. Is loading and unloading something your team still handles manually, or is that already automated?
cases.reason: Purpose and public detail lead to one task question; it does not claim manual work or robotics interest. This is the owner's illustrative direction, not approved send text.
